claims.status: Qualified result; not a uniformly smaller approximation factor
claims.scope: An exact-arithmetic tie-enumeration algorithm and a pointwise strict squared-error inequality. A limiting family explicitly rules out claiming a uniformly improved worst-case constant.

claims.status: Candidate proof under the stated identifiability and measure hypotheses
claims.scope: A bounded normalized-decomposition graph, semialgebraic volume growth and Gaussian integrability give the proposed first-moment result.

claims.status: Candidate proof of the generic target
claims.scope: A three-slice Koszul flattening and an explicit commutator minor provide the proposed generic lower bound; a moment-map argument supplies the matching Vandermonde upper bound.

claims.status: Candidate counterexample, with an exact small certificate
claims.scope: For h=(1,0,1,0,3,0,-1), the order-six binary tensor has the H-eigenvalue -1, whereas the order-three dimension-three tensor has only positive real H-eigenvalues. An explicit family generalizes the obstruction.

claims.status: Candidate proof of both requested degree formulas
claims.scope: The manuscript proposes a logarithmic compactification, boundary subtraction and generic-degree-one argument, yielding 24 binom(n+1,3) for m=2 and 24 n^2 binom(n,2) for m=3.

claims.status: Candidate proof of both reduced component degrees
claims.scope: For the specified unweighted curve, the manuscript proposes isotropic degree 2d and nonisotropic degree 6(d-1), using a binary critical polynomial and a multiplicity-one factorization argument.
